gpu0.name: nnunet_native_matched
cmds: if [ ! -f $OUT/scores/nnunet_native_matched.json ]; then pip install -q nnunetv2==2.8.1 && export nnUNet_raw=$(dirname $(find /kaggle/input -maxdepth 9 -type d -name Dataset001_KidneyVessel | grep -v nnunet_results | head -1)) nnUNet_preprocessed=/tmp/nn/pre nnUNet_results=$(find /kaggle/input -maxdepth 6 -type d -name nnunet_results | head -1); echo raw=$nnUNet_raw results=$nnUNet_results; python -m benchmark.run_nnunet predict --tag native --match-intensity --workers 1 --roi-dir $ROI_DIR --pred-root $OUT/preds && python -m benchmark.score_many --search $OUT --roi-dir $ROI_DIR --out-dir $OUT/scores --parallel 1 nnunet_native_matched; fi
